explanation: Campbell's Soup Cans (1962) has 32 canvases, one for each variety the company sold at the time. Warhol had worked as a commercial illustrator before turning to fine art.

claims.text: Andy Warhol painted Campbell's Soup Cans.
Roy Lichtenstein, Keith Haring and Jasper Johns did not paint Campbell's Soup Cans.
Warhol's Campbell's Soup Cans (1962) consists of 32 canvases, one for each variety of soup Campbell's then sold.
Before his fine-art career, Warhol worked as a commercial illustrator.
